name: Reverse Brainstorming
deliverable: High-volume generation of ways to intentionally cause failure

steps.text: Reframe the goal as sabotage: ask how to guarantee the failure you fear, and write that question where everyone can see it.
Send the room to write anti-solutions on red notes, one failure tactic per note, for a timed eight minutes.
Cluster the notes by failure vector, such as friction, opacity, latency, or overload, and name each cluster aloud.
Invert each cluster into a countermeasure on a green note, and insist on a mechanism rather than a negation.
Post each green note beside the red cluster it answers and read the strongest pair aloud.

failure: Half-working looks like a wall of funny red notes and a thin green column: the room enjoyed describing failure and ran out of energy before the inversion.
intervention: Close the sabotage round out loud, then require one green mechanism per red cluster before anyone may speak again.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: A reversal technique long used in creativity training; no origin given in the source.
